name: Microwave Paneer Bhurji
ingredients: 1 small onion and 1 tomato, finely chopped
¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp garam masala
steps: In a bowl, microwave the oil, cumin, onion and chilli covered for 2 minutes.
Add the tomato and spices and microwave for 2 minutes.
Add the paneer and salt, stir, and microwave for 2 minutes. Stir once halfway.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander.
note: Do not overcook paneer in the microwave or it turns rubbery.
